description.text: UFODRIVE was founded on the idea that you should be able to rent an electric vehicle in as little as three minutes, from your mobile device without hidden charges and unnecessary hassle. Once you download the app, follow the simple instructions to get registered and you’re good to go! Simply book and collect your car from one of our conveniently located central UFOBAYs, available 24/7, all year around, and hit the road in minutes. Redemption Instructions: Download the UFODRIVE app and follow signup instructions. Choose your location, vehicle and dates and complete your booking. You will receive confirmation once the booking has been received and you’re good to go.
